rationale: Tests interpretation of newborn thyroid screening TSH result and correct next step — anchored after the Diagnosis/Newborn Screening content block
Tests the correct starting dose of levothyroxine for congenital hypothyroidism — anchored after the Management content block
Tests DKA insulin infusion rate and the critical paediatric fluid rule — anchored after the Management/DKA Protocol content block
Tests understanding that T1DM in children results from autoimmune beta-cell destruction — anchored after the Clinical Presentation content block
Tests interpretation of combined findings (17-OHP, electrolytes, karyotype) to identify the most likely cause of DSD — anchored after the Interpretation/Differential Diagnosis content block
Tests the principle that sex assignment in DSD must NOT be made hastily at birth — anchored after the Counselling/Referral content block
Tests the age thresholds for defining precocious puberty in girls and boys — anchored after the Clinical Presentation content block
Tests understanding that GnRH analogues are used to halt central precocious puberty — anchored after the Management content block
Tests the structured approach to growth deviation — specifically mid-parental height calculation and velocity interpretation — anchored after the Plotting/Growth Velocity/MPH content block
Tests the referral decision principle — velocity is more important than height-for-age alone — anchored after the Referral Decision-Making content block
